title: Robert Wood's landscape prints
content: One of the most popular print artists in mid-20th century America wasRobert W. Wood(1889-1979).Robert Wood,October MornHis printOctober Mornsold more than a million copies in less than two weeks.He painted scenes of the Catskills of New York, the Rocky Mountains, The Grand Tetons, and Texas Hill Country.He grew up in England, but spent the rest of his long life in America. He lived in various places in the USA and traveled all over the country looking for subjects.A prolific painter, he produced over 5,000 paintings, many of them being made into prints during his heyday from the 1950s to the 1970s.He also produced a few art instruction books, including:How Robert Wood Paints Landscapes and Seascapes---Bio on RobertWood.net
